changes: Kept the adult identity-reference workflow and crimson satin concept while replacing the open-back, body-emphasis styling with a structured high-back satin gown and a non-suggestive three-quarter pose.

project_info.color_palette: deep crimson, oxblood, warm skin tones, and subtle metallic accents

main_subject.description: an adult woman whose face matches an approved identity reference exactly, wearing a deep-red high-back satin evening gown with draped shoulders and small unbranded earrings
main_subject.pose_and_expression: three-quarter turned pose with relaxed arm placement, head turned gently toward camera, and a calm confident smile

composition_elements.foreground: adult subject face, crisp satin folds, and controlled direct-flash highlights
composition_elements.background: deep-crimson vertical-panel wall with understated small metal rivets and no text or branding
composition_elements.visual_hierarchy: adult face and expression, red satin texture, then monochrome crimson architecture

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: direct editorial flash with controlled falloff and rich crimson color separation
lighting_and_atmosphere.atmosphere: cinematic, polished, intimate nightlife fashion without sexualized framing

technical_specs.rendering: ultra-photoreal editorial flash portrait, realistic skin texture, natural dynamic range, crisp satin, and very subtle film grain

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Use the uploaded approved adult non-public-figure identity reference and preserve the same adult facial identity, face structure, skin tone, and defining features. Create a photoreal editorial flash portrait of her before a deep-crimson vertical-panel wall with small metal rivets. She wears a deep-red high-back satin evening gown with draped shoulders, long glossy dark waves, small unbranded earrings, and refined wine-red evening makeup. Frame a vertical waist-up three-quarter turn; she looks gently back at camera with a calm confident smile. Use controlled direct flash, rich crimson color separation, realistic skin texture, crisp satin folds, no text, no logos, and a polished cinematic nightlife mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: different identity, identity blending, age shift, minor, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, open-back body emphasis, sexualized pose, nudity, beauty-filtered skin, logos, readable text, watermark, distorted hands, extra fingers

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: The approved adult non-public-figure identity reference is mandatory. A style reference is optional and may guide only the crimson palette, lighting, and composition.

assets.name: approved-adult-non-public-figure-identity-reference
assets.usage: Match facial identity and natural facial proportions only; do not blend identities or alter apparent age.

assets.name: crimson-flash-editorial-reference
assets.usage: Guide crimson palette, direct-flash character, and vertical composition only.
